props.name: viewType
props._description: `modal` opens the upload dialog over the screen; `onScreen` embeds the upload UI in place.

props.name: fileNamingPreference
props._description: `use_system_generated_name` renames each upload to a generated id; `keep_original_file_name` stores it under the name the user's file had.

props.name: enableEncryption
props._description: Encrypts the stored file. Anything reading it back must decrypt with the same setting.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.
